results.title: Codifying the Craft — Review of AI Engineering: Building ...
results.content: # **Codifying the Craft — Review of** AI Engineering: Building Applications with Foundation Models by Chip Huyen. ## How the new discipline of AI Engineering, codified by Huyen, is shifting the build-vs-buy calculus for foundation models and creating a new competitive advantage. > **TL;DR —** Chip Huyen’s *AI Engineering* is the definitive, practical guide for building real-world applications using foundation models like GPT-4. It’s a comprehensive “how-to” manual that moves beyond the hype, covering the entire lifecycle: choosing the right model, systematic evaluation (and why “vibe checks” fail), prompt engineering, using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to ground models in facts, knowing when (and when not) to fine-tune, and optimizing for production. > The book is praised by experts as the timely, essential resource for any engineer, product manager, or leader working in the AI space today. It codifies the new discipline of AI engineering, focusing on building reliable, valuable products, not just cool demos. Dr. Adnan Masood is an Engineer, Thought Leader, Author, AI/ML PhD, Stanford Scholar, Harvard Alum, Microsoft Regional Director, and STEM Robotics Coach.
